8.4.2 Crypto_NvBlock_ReadFrom_<NvBlock>
[SWS_Crypto_91024]Definition of callback function Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_NvBlock_
ReadFrom_<NvBlock>
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00117, SRS_CryptoStack_00118
⌈
Service Name
Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_NvBlock_ReadFrom_<NvBlock>
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_NvBlock_ReadFrom_<NvBlock> (
const void* NvmBuffer
)
Service ID [hex]
0x17
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
NvmBuffer
The address of the buffer where the data can be read from.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: callback function has been processed successfully any
other: callback function has been processed unsuccessfully
Description
This function is called by NVM to let the crypto driver copy the key data from the mirror of the
NVM ram block to an internal RAM buffer of the crypto driver.
The resulting function name shall be set to the container associated with the NvmBlock
Descriptor: {CryptoNvBlock/{CryptoNvBlockDescriptorRef} / NvMReadRamBlockFromNv
Callback
Available via
Crypto_cfg.h
⌋
